set -eu
cd /opt/herdr
curl -fsSLo herdr "https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr/releases/download/$${HERDR_VERSION}/herdr-linux-x86_64"
curl -fsSLo ttyd "https://github.com/tsl0922/ttyd/releases/download/$${TTYD_VERSION}/ttyd.x86_64"
gh="gh_$${GH_VERSION#v}_linux_amd64"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/$${GH_VERSION}/$${gh}.tar.gz" | tar -xz --strip-components=2 "$${gh}/bin/gh"
chmod +x herdr ttyd gh
# Seed herdr's config on first boot only; herdr and Settings write to it later
mkdir -p /home/vscode/.config/herdr
[ -f /home/vscode/.config/herdr/config.toml ] || printf '[theme]\nname = "vesper"\n' > /home/vscode/.config/herdr/config.toml
if /opt/herdr/herdr status server | grep -q "status: running"; then exec /opt/herdr/herdr; else echo "herdr server is not running yet, reload this page in a few seconds"; sleep 5; fi

mkdir -p /data/serverfiles/insurgency/cfg && cp /insserver.cfg /data/serverfiles/insurgency/cfg/insserver.cfg && cp /motd.txt /data/serverfiles/insurgency/motd.txt && chown -R 1000:1000 /data && echo "Setup complete"

[rack-ups]
  driver = "usbhid-ups"
  port = "auto"
  vendorid = "10AF"
  productid = "0001"
  product = "LiebertPSI"
  serial = ""
  vendor = "Emerson Network Power"
  bus = "002"

[upsmon]
  password  = "${SECRET_NUT_PASSWORD}"
  actions = SET
  instcmds = ALL
  upsmon primary

MONITOR rack-ups@localhost:3493 1 upsmon "${SECRET_NUT_PASSWORD}" primary
POLLFREQ 15
POLLFREQALERT 5
HOSTSYNC 15

/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.title: external-dns helm release
/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.name: external-dns
/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.doc: ExternalDNS is a Kubernetes add-on that automatically manages the creation and updates of DNS records for services running in your cluster. It integrates with a variety of DNS providers, such as CloudFlare DNS, Amazon Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, and more, to ensure that your applications are easily accessible from anywhere with a DNS name. With ExternalDNS, you can simplify the process of managing DNS records for your home lab, eliminating the need for manual updates and reducing the risk of errors.

0:
[INPUT]
  name tail
  alias kubernetes
  path /var/log/containers/*.log
  parser containerd
  tag kubernetes.*

[FILTER]
  name kubernetes
  alias kubernetes
  match kubernetes.*
  buffer_size 0
  merge_log on

  kube_tag_prefix kubernetes.var.log.containers.
  k8s-logging.parser on
  k8s-logging.exclude on
  namespace_labels off
  annotations on

[FILTER]
  name modify
  match kubernetes.*
  add source home-cluster

[FILTER]
  name nest
  match kubernetes.*
  wildcard pod_name
  operation lift
  nested_under kubernetes
  add_prefix k_

[FILTER]
  name nest
  match kubernetes.*
  operation lift
  nested_under k_labels
  add_prefix k_labels_

[FILTER]
  name modify
  match kubernetes.*
  rename k_labels_app.kubernetes.io/instance app
  rename k_labels_app.kubernetes.io/name app
  rename k_labels_app app
  rename k_labels_k8s-app app
  rename k_container_name app

[OUTPUT]
  Name http
  Match kubernetes.*
  host victoria-logs-server.observability.svc.cluster.local
  port 9428
  uri /insert/jsonline?_stream_fields=stream,k_namespace_name,k_pod_name,app&_msg_field=log&_time_field=date
  format json_lines
  json_date_format iso8601
  compress gzip

name: flux-webhook
group: external
client:
  dns-resolver: tcp://1.1.1.1:53
conditions:
  - "[STATUS] == 404"
